retrievalProfile.description: A centered close-up portrait with a top-aligned typographic header featuring a heavy slab-serif title and a secondary sans-serif subtitle.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a male subject with long hair, set against a blurred, neutral background. The top of the frame is occupied by two lines of text: a large, outlined slab-serif name and a smaller, solid sans-serif title, both contained within a thin white border that frames the entire image.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-subject proximity creates a sense of intimacy and directness
The white border contains the composition and separates it from the bleed
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool, dark clothing and muted background
The heavy slab-serif font anchors the top-heavy typographic hierarchy
coreInvariants: Thin white outer border framing the entire composition
Top-aligned text block with two distinct font weights
Shallow depth of field focusing on the subject's eyes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large slab-serif text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the line of the shoulder/guitar neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and text occupy most of the frame, with small pockets of blurred background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the clothing and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy off-white for the border and subtitle text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon for the primary title fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the text and the dark background elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky slabs with high contrast outlines
Secondary text uses uniform stroke weight with no serifs
All caps for both levels of hierarchy
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'O' in the primary title feature a double-stroke outline effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, heavy slab serif with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and western feel
Provides the necessary weight and clarity for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with long brown hair and a goatee, wearing a dark shirt with embroidered cuffs, looking directly at the camera. Use a shallow depth of field with a blurred, earthy-toned background. Frame the entire image with a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, burgundy slab-serif font with a cream outline at the top left. Directly below it, add the title in a smaller, solid cream sans-serif font. Ensure both are in all caps and left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the white border present around the entire image?
Is the primary text a heavy slab serif with an outline?
Is the subject's face in sharp focus with a blurred background?

mustRedesign: Do not use lowercase letters in the header
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face
postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab-serif font is sufficiently heavy
Verify the white border is consistent on all four sides
Ensure the subtitle is perfectly aligned with the start of the main title
Confirm the subject's eyes are the focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate Portrait + Slab-Serif Header + Keyline Border
